entry.title: TREEGONE 1.0.9
entry.summary: A Trigon-6-style 6- or 12-voice poly: three oscillators with blended shapes, sync, osc 3 LO, noise, feedback and drive, three filters (4-pole OTA, ladder, 2-pole SVF), two ADSRs, audio-rate LFO, poly mod, vintage, distortion, two effects, unison with chord memory, arp and poly sequencer. ECO and HIGH quality. Panel-style touch pages.
